notes.title: Asking for feedback - Community and development
notes.content:
Hey dear players! Feel free to skip to tl;dr at the bottom if you don't feel like reading this novel!

[h1]The setup[/h1]

It's been a wild ride and the game changed a real lot since the first days of early access, I took action every time the community told me something was bad, good or broken.

I'm gonna tell you what the plan was when I started, which is something I told some people privately but I never openly said, the plan was to just take this attitude, and keep making the game bigger until is way too big to ignore.

This week, after the launch on Steam and on Android a few players have been very vocal, which has helped immensely, and it's been recommended by a journo, so there's that! 
[url=https://gamesardor.net/top-steam-games-to-look-out-for-in-april-2025/#vindictive-drive-2-maidbot-archive]https://gamesardor.net/top-steam-games-to-look-out-for-in-april-2025/#vindictive-drive-2-maidbot-archive[/url]

[h1]What I need[/h1]

The thing is, I've reached a point where expansion has stopped in terms of players, to keep this game profitable I need to ask you for your feedback, opinions, complaints, everything.

Don't be shy, and don't pull your punches (or the praise, if that's what you got!)
A game is as good as it treats its community, I need more talk online, so that YouTubers finally notice this thing, so that press also chooses to pick it up.

There is (currently) only one YouTuber making content for the game, so check out Vicky Spade:  [url=https://www.youtube.com/@VickySpade]https://www.youtube.com/@VickySpade[/url]

[b]The game is severely lacking in guides[/b], unfortunately, I don't have the time to put these together myself because it's time I feel it's better used into implementing the things player want into the game, and in all honesty, it always feels like a race against time to keep a small studio like this running, I've been trying to send it to appstores, dealing with bureocracy, trying to find better strategies to market it, it's just too much.

With how complex the game is getting, and the many builds possible with the Maidbots and buffs/upgrades/adoption, the playstyles are growing more varied than even I can figure out

I'm not complaining though, this is what I wanted, it's actually a dream come true.

[h1]In a nutshell, if you feel like it, please:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Give me your feedback, ideas, reviews, suggestions etc
[*]Those confident enought to make guides, please do, we have a [url=https://vindictive-drive-2.fandom.com/wiki/Vindictive_Drive_2_Wiki]wiki[/url] and you can always ask me if you have doubts, add me on Discord, I'm bal_dev or at @boukensha_bal on X
[*]Those who know youtubers, please suggest them to cover the game either of the Steam or Mobile version,(or the manga) I don't mind giving free keys for it
[*]Those who know any press you find cool, please send them a messege
[/list]

Thank you for reading and playing, I appreciate you all, back to production! I'm working on the new collab Maidbot as I write this.
love

-Bal

notes.title: The Final Step
notes.content:
[h1]Summary:[/h1]

This is an enormous update that puts the game in a different league in terms of quality, not much has been added in terms of new features, but a lot has been added in terms of game experience and quality of life, and it opens the doors for amazing things in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/e8f7816be9468c47f55244f9e56e7fe818d8cff4.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Android Version live
[*]Leaving Early Access
[*]Added user "Officer Accounts"
[*]Changes to progression
[*]The player as an Officer in the Auriga
[*]Arris buffs
[*]Official Art gallery
[*]Big perfomance improvements
[*]UI and graphics upgrade
[*]Menus simplified
[*]Auto Save
[/list]

[h1]Android Version[/h1]

Now you can download the Android version in the official website, it is being sent to appstores right now, but so far the game is available to download in TapTap and as a standalone APK.
The save files that you generate with your registered account will be usable in all versions of the game, so you can play it on PC and Mobile under the same account.

[previewyoutube=LhrMDfm3uWo;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks to Vicky Spade for showing the mobile game!

The Mobile game plays exactly like any twin stick shooter, controls very easily and it's very straightforward.

[h1]User Accouts[/h1]
You can set a name for your character and register using an email and password, you will be required to confirm your email, if you lose your password, you can tell me and I will let you set a new one, I plan on setting an automated password recovery system however.

[h1]Differences between Mobile and PC[/h1]

As it stands VD2MA is at 1.0, so both versions are very similar except for the player having access to the bridge in the Steam version, the bridge is not necessary for the game as its uses have all been transferred to Hex's dialogue screen, the game saves automatically, which is something players have been asking me for ages, and Maidbots are crafted automatically as their requirements are met.

The reasons for this are two, making the game's operation simple and reworking the bridge into a new community area, the plan is to give it a new look and use it for Kickstarter NPCs, I didn't have any room left for them before, but now I am working to accomodate the area so I can add more of them.

The Mobile version is FREE TO PLAY, and probably will only have ads to support itself, as of right now it doesn't have ads, but don't worry, I promise to not make them invasive, I will probably make them just optional for specific rewards that don't impact balance. I am a gamer like you, I know what bothers you so, I won't go to those places.

HOWEVER, we have to be fair, altough both versions will be updated simultaneously, the PC version costing money means that PC players will have certain additional perks, I've been thinking about things like skins for a long time, and I think this is the best time for those, cosmetics exclusive for the PC version that won't interfere with how the mobile players play. 

Right now this is primarily a sandbox game, but the reworked story will be PC exclusive.

[h1]Progression, future competitions and Arris' Buffs[/h1]

Canon events have changed, now the game introduces Arris as a pilot already on the Auriga, waiting for the new Officer, a character the player will name, Arris and Hex will be assisting you now.

Once the story rework comes, it will still focus Arris, but the player will have some impact as a character as well.

As I mentioned earlier, Maidbots are crafted automatically, their requirements have been made MUCH easier because I needed to wipe save files to build this new save system, BUT, you now have cloud saves and you will never lose your progress from now on.

This also means I can keep track of which Maidbots players prefer, who beats FAZZ or reaches far in the Stygian Traverse, or even who has the most alfajores! 
This means I can host competitions and events, start the tryhard mode!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/024ce598692415a7bd4187bdedb071a1857b3b67.jpg[/img]
You can now visit and interact with Arris, she will provide you with buffs if you get enough points, which you get by being in combat, My purpose with this system is to build a skill trees feature in future updates, so get the hang of the three possible buffs and let me know which one is your favorite so I can properly branch them!

[h1]Art Gallery[/h1]
In the collab area you now have access to all the new art in the game, I will update it regularly and upload cool pics ideal for phone backgrounds and transparent pngs!

This was all possible thanks to you and thanks to the incredible people who got my back on Kickstarter, a special thanks to Chaotic Helleaven, if you love Rika, check them out! She's got her own manga and they also have a vtuber group with many cool characters that may actually join us in the game soon.

notes.title: News: The future, the project and more.
notes.content:
It's been a year of this project, I wasn't planning to invest more than one year in it, but, the community taught me this year that I can make a much better game than I originally planned.

[h1]The rebuild: Part 2[/h1]
When this project started it was a broken mess with not so many bugs, but bugs that were super serious like the infamous Demon Lag, which, for those blessed enough to not know, was a bug that froze your game after a playing for long enough, making you lose progress and brain cells.

The bug inspired me to make a total remake of the programming of the game, the game is now stable, it plays and functions like a game should and while the update came with a graphic update, my focus was to make it play good.

The next update will start to include several graphic updates, I want to rebuild the game in terms of graphic design and art quality, I can do so much better than this, and the reason is very simple, this year I did absolutely nothing but to dedicate my time to draw and work on the project

notes.title: MASSIVE REWORK! Biggest update yet! Come and see!
notes.content:
Here's a summary of everything because this is gonna be long.
It's a total rebuild, if you haven't played in a while [b]I recommend starting over[/b], it's a new experience, I promise.

To make it short, I made the game again from scratch and made it look better too.
[previewyoutube=B1fO9qitNp0;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*]Ark Royal and Rei
[*]All maps redesigned and rebuilt from scratch, but better
[*]New aggro system
[*]New distance based rendering system
[*]New sprites for ALL MAIDBOTS!
[*]Lullastasia rework!
[*]New inventory system with built enemy encyclopedia
[*]New tutorial
[*]Zero advice in the city
[*]Lots of UI improvements
[*]Lag demon glitch fixed (this thing is what inspired this whole rework)
[*]New Xera battle!
[*]Stygian Traverse rework!
[*]New Kit guides for ALL MAIDBOTS!
[*]Auriga bridge simplified, more to the point and with room for Kickstarter NPCs
[*]Balance changes on several Maidbots
[*]New Upgrade System
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/0c6e6cf1c50a436a26676dde1c72ac753311a9fe.png[/img]

[h1]The Rebuild:[/h1]
All maps have been rebuilt from scratch, now when you deploy in the city, you will load up an entire district to explore, the city map now looks different also, with the addition of North Circle District in 4N to replace the previous 6 to 7N area.

Two rendering systems have been put in place, they both work leagues better than what we had before, but from the feedback gathered in this update I will decide on which one to focus.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/f519e49785ffd7d3067380aaf83c482780a28017.png[/img]

South and North Circle Districts work on an aggro system that activates the enemies as you approach, the rest of the city and Stygian Traverse works on a distance based rendering system, which creates all objects and deletes them depending on how far you are from them.

Bigger areas also mean players HP won't be replenished so often, forcing the player to be cautious, also, I just noticed I put a [b]REALLY CRUEL MINE[/b] in the Natural Reserve, sorry in advance it will be patched asap, though you spawn in the same spot so its just a minor inconvenience.

Also the aggro system, now when you are detected by an enemy, other nearby enemies may approach you as well when in range.

All the enemies have been modified to adapt to these changes, the bosses are generally tougher now, but you can still abuse Zyrenette to get you past half of them. More about her below.

That reminds me the Return Spots are now bigger and work better, I'm sure you will love that. The previous ones were awful, what was I even thinking!?

[h1]New player experience and Quality of Life changes[/h1]
The game has been described as a souls like, that doesn't necessarily mean new players need to get anihilated and struggle before they manage to get anything done, so, several things have changed for them.

The bridge now connects to the essential NPCs, they will immediately take you to the tutorial, where Zero explains the mechanics and UI, afterwards, the normal dialogues of the bridge are unlocked, the UI of the bridge NPCs has been updated to make things more simple, it also looks better, so, yay.

After that, you will deploy in the city with Zero, now, the chat feature will have some common questions answered, this feature will be expanded on depending on how players use it.

This brings me to:

[h1]A more helpful inventory/city map[/h1]

Even if you hate to read and remember crafting materials, now, in the city map you have a list of enemies and how many you need to kill to get which maidbot, and location also.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/4d22e3bbda0a581488307cff3c04b6641fe5115b.png[/img]

The enemies' list also has a description that shows what they do for the tricky ones.

[h1]Maidbot stuff[/h1]
All maidbots have new sprites and kit guides that you can consult in the city, that was a lot of work, now they all have cool animations as you use them.

[h1]New Collab Maidbot: Rei![/h1]

Rei is here! The adorable vampire streamer is ready and offers a very edgy playstyle with a fast special that drains your HP for very high damage and a basic attack that restores it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/010c267f021be6f5cc252c48fa6e895b44577a7b.png[/img]

You can get Rei by catching Rei(as a bat) in Beluga Lake,(it's a random encounter, leaving and entering the area may be a cheap way to trigger it, its intended to be found by accident by unsuspecting players but if you're reading this you probably deserve a hint) and visiting the twitch channel from the [b]Collab Area[/b]

If you like the game's Rei, you will adore the real one, take a look at her [url=https://www.twitch.tv/inourei]Twitch channel[/url]! 
For real it's fun, ask anyone there I actually watch the streams. Even more than that, making this character I ended up making a good friend that I appreciate a lot.

[h1]New Ultra Maidbot: Ark Royal![/h1]

Ark Royal is a new Generation 2 Maidbot! She's a melee dasher with a shield that absorbs damage for powerful counter attacks, her dashing speed is slower than Shireywha and she can't use her shield while attacking, which makes her a powerful but fairly balanced as far as Ultras go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/01f7363e352972e0f8608e4a1dff174638f66819.png[/img]

This Maidbot is voiced by the charismatic and skilled [url=https://x.com/SavviLee]Savvi Lee[/url]. Give her a warm welcome!

[h1]Lullastasia Rework![/h1]

The Dark Maiden has a new kit and a new look, now she provides a balanced attack and defense combo, she now rewards high mobility by attacking only once on close range but restoring HP, forcing the player into a safer playstyle, the aggressive "in your face" moves belong to Kyvzaki.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/101f8c46d9fea6518abc315d1781f862aad052ab.png[/img]

Her hook is still there, but she will now be the one dragged to enemies dealing huge damage and attacking multiple enemies if they are close enough to her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/9a00e58389ccb4b12bbff2171997e1dd6075db1a.png[/img]

I think she's really fun now.

The old Lullastasia was glitchy and offered only a hook which was boring for how difficult she is to get, defeating Gyubeeh and Kidovah is no joke, which reminds me...

[h1]Stygian Traverse rework[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/b1ad008e1dd88f194983836c3a9dd0187c295ddd.png[/img]

The Stygian Traverse now is an endurance survival dungeon, where your score is the distance traveled instead of just floors, the frequency of enemy attacks is random and vary from very quiet to hell on earth, where you can be attacked by multiple Freija Drones at the same time and they move fast now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/7449a5840475af2cf2cb31330f6d862c9d34d74e.png[/img]

Gyubeeh and Kidovah themselves had their new paint job, they are now tougher, with double the HP they had, more firepower and shields that return your attacks and heal them, the area in which you fight them is also tighter, no longer bound by walls, but if you step out of it it's instant death, so speed buffs that dominate the city can be a disadvantage here.

[h1]New Upgrade System[/h1]
Now you can upgrade your Mecha! We have four upgrades now, it's a low and safe number you know, more will be added depending on how broken the builds players come up with are gonna be.

[h1]More Maidbot Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Mar's nuke has a slightly slower travel speed, making it "safer" to use, her basic attack is faster, the nuke itself also deals more damage, making her more reliable because I found that people actually play her so, ey!
[*] Kyvzaki and Shireywha hit harder
[*] Vu's knife hitbox is bigger
[*] Zyrenette's Stardust Rebellion retains its broken damage but now costs 15% HP to use, which makes her a very powerful character in the city but extremely unreliable in the Stygian Traverse.
[/list]

[h1]Final Boss rework, XERA![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/1c54e63935ecf4bbbbfc5ed4784a4c10b4033a40.png[/img]
Xera now gives you the epic fated battle you deserve, she's the toughest while also giving you a show of bullet hell and looking very pretty while doing so, yes her look has been slightly updated as well.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/e7c93351ddff2333bd33f02ab0500faacee5f058.png[/img]
[h1]Lag Demon slain![/h1]

The Lag Demon glitch which has terrorized the game for months is finally gone, it was the whole reason behind this rework to be honest, so, a blessing in disguise, from a curse to an opportunity, as thanks for improving the game, we are gonna make a Maidbot in its honor!
Stay tuned for news on this! If you have any ideas for this new Maidbot I am all ears!

With that being said, this was also the toughest period of development, I am exhausted, this update's name is Heart and Soul because it's quite honestly what I have put in it, but I wanted to make it a statement, there's probably things to fix as it's all brand new systems, but at its worst it is still leagues superior and more fun than the game we had before.

These new systems, also opened the door for new fun stuff that I can't reveal yet as I have enough to deliver on my plate as it is, but, opportunities for a better game keep coming, this was tough but worth it.

As I am writing this it's 2:30 AM and I still need to make the trailer/s and the new maidbots' spotlight videos, and tomorrow I have to fix some bugs I found.

These videos will be added ASAP, I'm on it.

[h1]Known bugs:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dragging the slider on the enemy encyclopedia will trigger some maidbots LMB actions
[*] A couple buildings on the Natural Reserve need a clipping fix
[*] Not a bug but the mine I mentioned in the Natural Reserve is an unfair cheap shot
[*] Ark Royal's planned carpet bombing skill has been removed before even releasing her because it ended up feeling way too overtuned, though it's correct in her kit details, its still there in the card so, it has to go.
[/list]

Please send me your Stygian Traverse score and alfajor counts if you want, it will matter soon, thank you for being there.

Love

-Bal

notes.title: Illustrious and Beluga Lake are here! Vindictive Drive 2: Maidbot Archive
notes.content:
[h1]Beluga Lake is here![/h1]
[previewyoutube=yKBn_1iqAsE;full][/previewyoutube]

Beluga Lake is a residential district of New Noir City, lots of small apartment buildings near the lake, a nice view and a large concentration of powerful machines in the center of SEITEN's fleet.

The new area is classified a Red danger zone, every single enemy has as much HP as regular bosses, there's enemies and structures with new diverse skills that will surprise you and most of all...

[h1]Athena Battlestation[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/c8f37b9952595a5a9468a02653b45fdf4e05447c.png[/img]
Sitting in the first Black danger zone block, this massive ship has enormous firepower and endurance, it won't go down in one attempt, it has two hangars with fighter jets that will constantly attack you as well as absorb damage from your projectiles to protect Athena.

[h1]Illustrious | The first Generation 2 Battleship girl you can try[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/1a57c4b1a6ae6421f3ca13fbd078dd7a44412005.png[/img]
A girl with a powerful kit and a nasty attitude comes to cause havoc.
If you manage to conquer Beluga Lake, you will be rewarded(or punished depending on how you see it) with Illustrious, one of the three Battleship sisters who comes from the fictional country of Britain, or so she says.
Illustrious will treat you like trash and bully you, but if you manage to impress her she will start treating you well.
Her kit plays around her personality, if you land her airstrikes properly, your cooldown will reset, enabling you to recast the skill as long as you don't mess up, if you do mess up, it will be extended and you will suffer a defense cut.

You can't fix her.

Illustrious is voiced by Rachel Herring, an amazing British VA and you can follow her in [url=https://x.com/JustPeachxo]X/Twitter[/url].

[h1]Archive and general layout changes[/h1]

I rebuilt the Archive! Now it's easier to navigate and efficient for future updates, and as you will see, it gives me a lot of room to add new features in the future like unlockable pics and stories, but for now, this is the start of something cool.

Changed the hud in the city so that it doesn't get in the way of your shooting, I also made the Auriga more compact and easier to navigate, Arris is faster now too, you'll get to do what you want quicker.

Now Hex will comment on the number of alfajores you steal from her, the dialogues change every 10 alfajores and it ends at 200 for now, disappointing, I know, but I'll add many more as soon as I get a second of free time in a couple days, these are surprisingly easy to produce so hey, people seem to like stealing from that box for some reason.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/24e3f66e0d2cde7c631c6c4b0ac105d3794d7b3f.png[/img]

I'll start working on the Collab characters, there's 7 of them on queue, but there's one that is HUGE, and I mean, ENORMOUS, LARGE, but you'll see what I mean, please stay tuned to my [url=https://x.com/boukensha_bal]X/Twitter[/url] where I will announce it soon.

[h1]Progression update for new players[/h1]

Implemented a series of changes part of the transition into the Mecha Maidbot sandbox style that I started the last update, mostly changes that will help new players get used to the game quicker, these include:

[olist]
[*]All story chapters now require a minimum number of Maidbots owned
[*]Stealth missions removed entirely until I can figure out a more polished system for them
[*]Minor changes to UI and map, small clues on how to do things here and there
[*]Some of the G2 Maidbots' skills can be checked in Wagie's store, they are coming soon along with a map expansion
[/olist]

The game has had too punishing of a learning curve for new players, especially those not used to the genre, old players have been waiting for new content for a while, the Kickstarter campaign is being too time consuming and I'm still working on bug fixes, but if the campaign succeeds I can accelerate the proccess massively just like I did at the beginning.

[h1]How you can help[/h1]
Development has slowed down because the budget is dead and sales have been bad, on top of that, the Kickstarter campaign is not doing too good.

Even if you cannot contribute to the campaign, you can be of great help if you share it and there are some benefits for you if you do it, there's an art raffle and a Steam giftcard giveaway:

It's being a very hard time for the project, but, I will do my best to push through, thank you all for your support.

notes.title: Spring Sale discount! Announcing new Maidbot class "Battleship" and more!
notes.content:
[h1]Generation 2 "Battleship Maiden" under production now![/h1]

[url=https://twitter.com/boukensha_bal/status/1767667169960079434][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GIf-M-XXIAAXhRq?format=png&name=small[/img][/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/boukensha_bal/status/1766161815266902231/photo/1][img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GIKpFvrW0AAqsqj?format=png&name=small[/img][/url]

[h2]The new Generation will feature a new class, Battleship. A strategy based class.[/h2]

They generally have weaker stats than the regular Melee, Ranged and Support Maidbots, but they have special abilities that alter the flow of the game and maps, some can target a specific block for bombardment or artillery, some coordinate special attacks with aircraft, some will call in aircraft that drops healing items, some have special bonuses when you travel to faraway locations, you will have to configure your Battleship girl while in the Sortie screen and have precise timing for your travels.

You have a small time window to use their special effects, so plan your coordinated efforts and exercise good timing and they will reward you greatly.

[h1]Official website and info![/h1]

You can visit our company website at [url=https://www.bokensha.org/]https://www.bokensha.org/[/url], here you can find some cool stuff like the [url=https://www.bokensha.org/maidbot-card-list]Official Maidbot card list[/url] and [url=https://www.bokensha.org/auditions]Auditions info[/url].

I've been talking to lots of talented VAs, there is a lot of wonderful artists excited to provide their voices for the project! 
Some of them have amazingly noteworthy backgrounds, others, are underdogs of outstanding skill and rising stars, they will all get a fair shot at voicing the Battleship girls!

As always, check out my [url=https://twitter.com/boukensha_bal]Twitter/X[/url] if you wanna learn more.

Thank you for your support, it means the world to me, if you enjoy the game, please share it and talk about it, all comments help, I always enjoy interacting with players, we need some coverage from Youtubers/Streamers, so every bit of noise we can get helps! 
Most of the money I make from sales will go to production so, the game will get bigger the better it does.

With love

-Bal

notes.title: A Mecha-Maidbot takeover plan
notes.content:
[h1]Summary:[/h1]

Player feedback has shown this is now a game about Maidbots and Mecha, this update sets the tone for what's to come.

[h1]A new game start:[/h1]

The game now begins at the Auriga, the player gets to meet the crew right away and jump into action, boss hunting and Maidbot crafting, we have a new intro sequence voiced by Notoh as Vitakrosis.

[previewyoutube=jMlZ_wGQ2kw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Hex's new interface and artistic goals:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/c87db908bf3b695fa8dd11822046512c838e7358.png[/img]

Hex's interface now has an updated look, its purpose is to give the player complete freedom about what they wanna do, if they want to go to collect Maidbots, they can do that, if they want to go and view the prologue and graphic novel content, they can do that too, I feel the first few minutes are important, way too important to be restricted to the prologue mission, so we have this now!

All of this doesn't mean much for players that already have a save file with all Maidbots collected though, they won't be affected and their progression is intact.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/c2b85e2b1e458f2df53746c2911eea32a1c512f5.png[/img]

Additionally, I wanna update the art on all areas, I am far better artist than I was when I started working on this project, that is why you will find at this point a lot of art that is inconsistent in quality with other pieces, replacing all...it'll be a grind, but I am always ready for it.

[h1]Manga updates:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/ec8eed769e5ec851bd3820e3db5a7d60d64c6e5e.png[/img]

Chapter 3 of Vitakrosis is under production now, it will be ready soon, for those unaware, you can read the origin of Vitakrosis here:
[url=https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/vitakrosis-the-art-of-revenge/list?title_no=933635]https://www.webtoons.com/en/canvas/vitakrosis-the-art-of-revenge/list?title_no=933635[/url]

[h1]The reason for these changes and the future:[/h1]

I wanna drive development to focus on Mecha and Maidbots, the following updates will be about including more machines to have as option other than the Hexsuit X, so you can mix with Hex's buffs and different Maidbots to get fun builds, more Maidbots of course, and to give them an active role in the story.

The feel of the game will transition from tech noir to a more 90s Mecha anime style. The game will also have some sort of change on its name, a subtitle that I haven't decided yet and a new logo, all around new feel.

Remember to follow me on [b][url=https://twitter.com/boukensha_bal]Twitter/X[/url][/b] for real time updates on development, I have commissions open and other ways you can support me, it's been a rough month to say the least, I am severely lacking on exposure, I am trying to reach out to press and Youtubers, you can also help me with feedback or sharing my content, I appreciate you all for playing and I will use every critique to make a better game.

[h1]Bugs:[/h1]

Most...if not all...of the bugs are problems in the city and Stygian Traverse, I am working on programming a new way to proccess all these areas and its being a lot of work but it'll smash bugs like a Mar nuke, sorry for the dalay on those fixes.

Thank you.

-Bal

notes.content:

It's the biggest ever update in the history of Vindictive Drive 2, and the biggest update in my history as develoiper, please, let me know what you think! I gave my all on this one, and I will continue to try harder, so, here's a summary!

[h1]0.4.5 Trailer:[/h1]
[previewyoutube=IeIKn-sBuic;full][/previewyoutube]


[h1]Voice Acting by wonderful professional game and Anime VAs[/h1]

The first generation of Maidbots was named "The Maidbot Superstar Nonet" and not without reason, our new VAs come from very different yet equally impressive backgrounds, let me introduce them to you!

[h2]Abby Espiritu as Kyvzaki![/h2]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GD5ipjhWwAA_TKH?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
Abby is a remarkable voice actress with talent and versatility that earned her roles in Anime and videogames, with some notable titles such as Yu-Gi-Oh! games, Genshin Impact and Pokémon Masters EX under her belt, her skills and experience gave Kyvzaki the perfect hot headed tomboy voice. She is also a martial artist who can play the piano and guitar.

[h2]Dayeanne Hutton as Zyrenette![/h2]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GEEQgVTWkAADVZ8?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
An incredible VA with a lot of outstanding achievements, though most gamers will probably remember her for her very impactful role as Kate Marsh from Life is Strange, such a gifted talent is more than ideal to give life and spark to the Space Princess!

[h2]UkuLeili as Mar![/h2]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GD0WNOvX0AAF1Jh?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
UkuLeili has an impressive career with many roles in anime dubs under Crunchyroll, she's been in After-School Hanako-Kun and KamiKatsu, a VA with extensive training who continues to grow and eager to learn even more always, she gives Mar a very funny and wholesome voice that is gonna make you actually like cockroaches!

[h2]Vanessa Benoit as Shireywha![/h2]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GD_FyT1XsAETPHD?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
Vanessa also had roles in official Anime dubs and videogames, she's Naval in Tsukimichi! A VA who gives the Flash Blade Shireywha the perfect caring, motherly voice capable of getting serious for a good fight when you're in danger, you're in great hands!

[h2]Jennifer Alyx as Taikavoran![/h2]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GDuTFbwW8AAXgfU?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
This amazing VA brings the talent and the experience from the many remarkable roles in Anime under Crunchyroll, with some notable roles in Azur Lane, Little Witch Academia and Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha among many more, even with that in mind, I was very surprised with the character and life she gives to Taikavoran, our adorable volcano snail, funny, sweet and chaotic, you're gonna be surprised too!

[h2]Alyssa Ferrari as Zero![/h2]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GEJMs5QXEAMUQFk?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
Alyssa is a very energetic voice over artist who has been involved in her passion for acting since she was 8 years old, a professional with experience in TV/film, singing and digital art, whenever I am looking at her socials she is always working very hard. She gives Zero the perfect bubbly voice, you're gonna love her!

[h2]Tanja Tjong as Memorimo![/h2]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GDmB8QyW0AEj7Q4?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
A true rising star, Tanja is an incredible singer from Norway, aside from voice acting, she currently works hard streaming as a Vtuber, I watch her streams almost daily while programming or drawing, I really recommend taking a look at her stuff. Tanja gives Memorimo a very funny and adorable voice.

[h2]Taylor Morrison as Vu![/h2]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GDcHijEWsAAS6O7?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
Taylor is a talented VA and cosplayer who has been involved in music and the arts nearly her entire life, I was convinced she'd be perfect for Vu the second I heard her voice, to put it simply, she is to my taste the best yandere voice I've heard, and also, Taylor is the very first VA I ever worked with, and I am more than impressed.

[h2]Reagan Kathryn as Lullastasia![/h2]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GEIcWOpWYAEcWLZ?format=jpg&name=large[/img]
Reagan Kathryn is a Host, Voice Actress, and Cosplayer who gives Lullastasia an amazing cold but sweet tone.

[h1]First Ultra Series card | Vitakrosis, the Spirit of Revenge[/h1]
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GES2qboXYAIoJ-W?format=png&name=small[/img]
You can now get Vitakrosis in your team, the first of the Ultra Series, a special class of extremely powerful companions, though they are very hard to get also. Conquer the Stygian Traverse and the increasingly powerful Gyubeeh and Kidovah for a chance to get her.

The first Ultra is voiced by Notoh, a cool game developer and cosplayer who gives Vitakrosis a very soft, yet intimidating voice. Notoh was always a fan of the creepy and scary, in fact she's making a horror game right now, the perfect person for the role.

[h1]Hex Corner: Buffs and Community Maidbot Development [/h1]

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GFMNEmRWkAEPaBU?format=jpg&name=large[/img]

Now you can vote for your favorite Maidbot! The most popular one will get a special unique skin, also, I will produce more content for the Maidbots that you choose, more voice interactions and fun stuff!

Additionally, you can now give me suggestions for the next generation of Maidbots. Is there a particular design that you would like to see? Let me know! I read everything!

In the same place you can answer some questions from Hex and get a buff depending on the result, find out which buff has better synergy with your favorite Maidbot and how to creatively get the best of it.

notes.title: Vindictive Drive 2 0.4.4 | "ZERO RISING"
notes.content:
It's been an intense couple weeks, I wanted to come back to you with something that really shows I wanna put words into action, here's some of the new things!:

[previewyoutube=BdM8NxL2l0I;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]ZERO | GROWTH SYSTEM[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/9167e24397bd5927de0d9c5d8f318aaf390d1acb.png[/img]
Zero has always been just the starter maidbot to teach you the basics, now, altough she starts very weak, she can be trained and learn new hidden skills, from now on, the cards with a colored number will own this new system:

Zero gains experience by attacking enemies, naturally, large enemies that allow you to connect a lot of shots are best for this.

[h2]ZERO | CITY CHAT[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/d69236b2311e09d6694f715a5f5f93557104bac5.png[/img]
You can now chat with Zero in the city, with time I will increase the number of interactions, some of the interactions give experience for the growth system.

[h2]NEW INSTANCE | STYGIAN TRAVERSE DEPTHS[/h2]

The black clouds have descended on the eastern side of New Noir City, infecting a large number of machines, this is an endless instance and enemies attack you at complete random, on top of that, there's two very powerful bosses lurking in the shadows.

[h2]GYUBEEH AND KIDOVAH | BIOKERNEL CONSTRUCT BOSSES[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/c1704d966a6f166e6f5c2905de21d0ee23936541.jpg[/img]
The first of the Biokernel constructs, the Biokernel's response to Hexcorp's Maidbots, they are sassy, stylish, and verbally abusive, these two weirdos will keep getting stronger the deeper you go into the instance and continue to appear every 5 blocks.

[h2]VITAKROSIS | GUARDIAN SPIRIT OF REVENGE[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/943528a200d24d5603f47f8dbae92662313abe34.jpg[/img]
A bad omen, a warning of the tragedies to come, Vitakrosis has appeared somewhere in the Stygian Traverse Depths, her presence implies the destruction of this world.
She is mentor and protector of those who dedicated their lives to revenge, though her true intentions will remain a mystery, find Vitakrosis and you will receive a permanent stat boost.

[h2]LULLASTASIA | THE CALM DEATH[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/0d691d2d4bd00a93dbc3c4a7cf177dea8d2038cb.png[/img]
The new Maidbot has arrived, it is #9, Lullastasia, she's a gloomy and quiet girl who protects ancient tombs from would be treasure hunters, she drags enemies to you and finishes them with her Death Touch.

[h2]ART | ALL MAIDBOT PORTRAITS AND CARDS UPDATED[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/2d58e3282968cf460e1d811161a66a0523d71990.png[/img]
That took a while.

[h2]MEMORIMO REWORK[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44704977/7ea8c634e00adbfe20b7e07b0eb99637051ed1f5.png[/img]
Memorimo has always been kind of behind in terms of usability and performance, now, her skills have been updated with massive heals and buffs, she doesn't attack, but she protects!

[h2]BALANCE CHANGES | BUFFS[/h2]

Shireywha now has lifesteal, she recovers HP while attacking enemies
Kyvzaki now deals double damage if your HP drops below 20%
Mar's nuclear bombs deal more damage to make up for her possibly(most likely) kiling you sometimes

[h2]FINAL NOTES:[/h2]

I have fun making updates where I introduce new characters, this one was very challenging, please, let me know what you think, feedback is super important and critical for my progress, please post your thoughts here on Steam or feel free to contact me on Twitter/X at [url=https://twitter.com/boukensha_bal]@boukensha_bal[/url] or via Discord at Bal_Dev

Cheers!

notes.title: Vindictive Drive 2 getting ready for launch! Development details here.
notes.content:
Hello Steam! In this post I will share with you a lot of details about the direction of the project, what you can expect and more.

[h2]The plan:[/h2]
I intend to publish updates every 2-3 weeks, I am working on this solo, and I dedicate 6 to 8 hours a day to game development, except saturdays, I still dedicate some time to it on saturdays though.

I want the game to have 10 story chapters, and 100 Maidbots, I also want to expand the city with enough enemies to produce materials to craft all of them, that means, a much bigger city.
Judging by my progress during the Alpha stage I think I am capable of delivering as planned, [b]if this were to change[/b], I promise to keep you updated and be transparent about it.

[h2][b]Lorebook:[/b][/h2]
Halfway in development, depending on how steady things are, I wanna make a large lorebook with characters, terms, everything, it'll be free.

[h2][b]Coming next regarding development:[/b][/h2]
In order to make progress in the story and add more stealth missions, the city needs to be bigger, events in the city are tied to the plot, so, the first updates will be more city areas and Maidbots.
If you are already familiar with the game, to put it simple, before I move onto chapter 3, I need to expand the Biokernel Infected zone, add variety to the city design, a natural reserve behind Freija HQ, and Beluga Lake.

[h2][b]Uncertain: Voice Acting and original song[/b][/h2]
I'll be direct, those are two things I really want to have, but it'll all depend on the money I make.

[h2][b]What I need the most:[/b][/h2]
Feedback, do you like or dislike something? What is the direction you would like the project to take? How to improve it? Any suggestions or ideas?
Information is the most important asset for me, really, whatever you have to say is important, the whole point of Early Access is moving the game into the direction players want.

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]
